cli.syntax: lox config load-manager set-name FILE SELECTOR IO_INDEX NAME [--room ROOM] [--save-as PATH]
cli.identity: Reuse exact existing twelve-row/unique resolved ioIdx 0..11 resolver. Omitted ioIdx is zero. No identity normalization.
cli.mutation: Only matched Load/@nm; order/IDs/wires/flags/power/timing/unknown attributes and children stay unchanged.
cli.strings: Empty clears by omission, Unicode/spaces/whitespace-only/duplicates preserved exactly; no trim/default filling/truncation.
cli.conservative_subset: Reject control characters, U+2028/U+2029/U+FFFE/U+FFFF and more than 32767 UTF-16 code units. This bound is CLI policy, NOT recovered native maximum.
cli.semantic_noop: Absent and explicit-empty nm both resolve empty but retain their raw omission/spelling. In-place no-op writes nothing. Save-as uses ordinary writer without a new Document stamp.
cli.save: Ordinary DOM writer and Document stamp on actual changes; BOM/EOL preserved. Errors precede saving input/destination.
cli.output: Existing inspection output plus changed boolean in setter JSON; saved_to null for in-place no-op.
cli.dry_run: Unsupported; unchanged fail-closed admission before dispatch.
